    w   = p.wheel_w

    cut = cut.fuse(cq.Solid.makeCone(rb, rb + bch, bch, cq.Vector(0, 0, w - bch)))

    return outer.cut(cut)
```

def build(p):

    w   = p.wheel_w

                             cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
    body = body.fuse(cq.Solid.makeCylinder(ro, w - 2*ch,
                                           cq.Vector(0, 0, ch)))
    body = body.fuse(cq.Solid.makeCone(ro, ro - ch, ch,
                                       cq.Vector(0, 0, w - ch)))

    # bore cutter: lead-in, straight seat, lead-in
    cut = cq.Solid.makeCone(rb + bch, rb, bch,
                            cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
    cut = cut.fuse(cq.Solid.makeCylinder(rb, w - 2*bch,
                                         cq.Vector(0, 0, bch)))
    cut = cut.fuse(cq.Solid.makeCone(rb, rb + bch, bch,
                                     cq.Vector(0, 0, w - bch)))

    return body.cut(cut)
```
